messages:
Jordan (PM): Need a compact asset pack for next week's "Serve Better" launch: benchmark snapshot, hero tile for socials, one-page sales PDF, and export-ready copy table for EN/FR/DE. Due: Fri EOD.
Amanda (Growth): Prioritize hero tile + social caption variants so paid can queue. 2 copy variants per tile.
Lina (Design): Copy voice? Also confirm sizes: hero 1200x628, tiles 1080x1080, 1-pager A4.
Jordan (PM): Voice = technical but friendly. Tagline: \"Serve better LLMs 1 lower latency, lower cost.\" CTA = \"Register\". Sizes confirmed.
Lina (Design): I'll do 3 tile layouts (data-callout, product-shot, stat-quote). Will include text-only Figma page for translators and +25% padding for DE.
Tom (Legal): Quick flag: if we include partner logos on the 1-pager get written permission. Add legal footer text: \"© 2026 Redwood Inference. All rights reserved.\"
asset-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/servebetter/launch-pack 1: access set to anyone with link (view).
Amanda (Growth): UTM plan: campaign=serve-better-2026; source=paid_social|email; content=heroA|heroB. Include example UTM table in handoff.
Lina (Design): Export naming suggestion: launch/serve-better/<asset>-<variant>-<size>-v1.png. Will include alt-text drafts and 1-line captions for X/LinkedIn.
Jordan (PM): Great. Please @marketing when hero PNG/GIF is uploaded. Lina, ETA?
Lina (Design): Comps by Wed noon PT, first exports by Thu morning, full handoff Fri EOD.
